scope: Independent static review of quota driver and runner against frozen diagnostics driver and database/run.py; no build, workload or source edits.
conclusion: No correctness blocker found. Compilation and bounded behavioral smoke checks remain required before performance interpretation.
key_and_value_identity: make_key is unchanged: mix(id+seed) is a bijection on uint64, and key_size>=8 retains all bits. Both modes enumerate id_base+[0,records); permitted wrap in id+seed remains an invertible translation.
Value generation is unchanged: each inserter initializes value bytes to v. The per-worker random stream is used only for queries, which shared mode forbids.
Shared mode changes worker-to-key assignment and operation order, but not the complete key/value set. Fixed mode retains completed*inserters+index.
reservation_and_completion: The relaxed fetch_add on next_record gives each reservation a unique multiple of1024; min(1024,records-start) clips the last nonempty range. Independent IDs require no stronger memory ordering.
batch_next=batch_end=0 triggers a reservation before first use. A final partial batch inserts only its valid IDs; an empty reservation exits before key construction.
records<=UINT64_MAX/64 and actual8 workers leave ample room for final empty reservations. batch_end cannot exceed records, and id_base<=UINT64_MAX-records prevents ID addition overflow.

Count-limited mode has seconds0 and no rate limit or readers. Controller completion requires all worker done flags, written after deregistration. It cannot normally stop the last worker before that worker attempts its final empty reservation.

Each successful worker makes exactly one empty reservation, including workers with no completed inserts. Thus next_record=(ceil(records/1024)+8)*1024. Fixed-mode counts match floor((records+7-index)/8), including records<8.
Errors, signals, free-space stop and incomplete totals are rejected by process status/reason/error/close/count checks. An interrupted reservation cannot silently produce accepted missing keys.
restrictions_and_runner: Shared CLI rejects --open, inserter counts other than8, readers, positive seconds and open-loop rate limits. Existing resolved-record validation rejects zero-sized workloads; --records0 itself retains the inherited data-size-derived default behavior.
Runner always uses fixed-record diagnostic measurements and independently capped time-limited fixed-quota preconditions. Shared next_record checks apply only to shared measured runs.

Same frozen quota binary and setup are used for fixed and shared comparisons. Raw log mode, batch, target/completed count, maximum productive endpoint, worker totals and expected reservation counter are checked.
Worker completion spread ignores workers with zero completed inserts, so a tiny workload does not treat their zero last_end_ns as a real completion timestamp.
timing_and_comparability: Existing diagnostic snapshots remain unchanged. Productive end is the maximum successful final insert return timestamp, before final latency-accounting/publication, empty-reservation exit, deregistration, controller polling and close.

Exact body and drain wall/CPU fields retain worker_start-to-workers_joined and worker_start-to-after_close respectively. Productive throughput supplements these fields; it must not replace CPU accounting or end-to-end throughput.

Timed preconditions can have productive_end later than stop_request because an in-flight insert finishes after stop. Negative productive_end_to_stop_s is valid there; count-completed runs should order productive_end before stop.

Shared mode adds a relaxed atomic reservation per1024 records plus batch control and changes per-worker key ordering. It can reduce quota imbalance but does not guarantee identical compaction scheduling or eliminate a slow final batch.

Compare main/original/candidate within each mode using the same binary and mirrored ordering. A level difference between old diagnostics and new quota binaries is not attributable solely to quota mode; separate mode suites may also differ in thermal state.
suggested_bounded_validation: Both modes with a small positive record count not divisible by1024; verify complete reason, exact total, zero errors, successful close and expected counter.
A records1 or similarly sub-eight shared smoke exercises zero-completion workers and all eight final empty reservations.
Verify incompatible shared flags reject before running a database workload. Retain failed evidence.
For the final fixed-count comparison, inspect productive, body and drain throughput together with full process CPU/op and per-worker completion spread.
